programme.title: Mundial 2026: España - Bélgica
programme.desc: España está entre los ocho mejores equipos del Mundial, pero no se conforma. El conjunto de Luis de la Fuente pretende alcanzar las semifinales, algo que solo ocurrió en Sudáfrica. La cita con la historia es en Los Ángeles y el rival, Bélgica.

programme.title: Simeone. Revelado
programme.desc: El entrenador argentino del Atlético de Madrid se ha convertido en una pieza clave para plantar batalla al Real Madrid y FC Barcelona. Descubre su lado más personal en esta entrevista con DAZN.

programme.title: Destinos cruzados
programme.desc: Lamine Yamal y Kylian Mbappé representan un nuevo capítulo dentro de la larga historia de enfrentamientos entre el FC Barcelona y Real Madrid. El delantero español y francés están llamados a llevar esta confrontación a un nuevo nivel para erigirse como nuevo 'rey'.

programme.title: Mundial 2026: Argentina - Suiza
programme.desc: Con mucho sufrimiento, pero Argentina sigue adelante en su intento de revalidar el título Mundial. En cuartos, los de Leo Messi se miden a Suiza, equipo que busca un pase a semifinales inédito en su historia.

programme.title: Premier Corner by Guiness 0,0
programme.desc: Guardiola es uno de los entrenadores más reconocidos de la Premier League. En ''Premier Corner'', con Eneko Fernández, charlamos con el técnico catalán.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: At. Madrid - Real Madrid
programme.desc: Los mejores clubes del país protagonizan LaLiga, el campeonato de la regularidad del fútbol español. El torneo es una carrera de fondo en la que los equipos pelean por sus metas: la salvación, Europa, la Champions o el título. El Barcelona defiende corona.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Atlético de Madrid - Girona
programme.desc: Los mejores clubes del país protagonizan LaLiga, el campeonato de la regularidad del fútbol español. El torneo es una carrera de fondo en la que los equipos pelean por sus metas: la salvación, Europa, la Champions o el título. El Barcelona defiende corona.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: At. Madrid - Valencia
programme.desc: Los mejores clubes del país protagonizan LaLiga, el campeonato de la regularidad del fútbol español. El torneo es una carrera de fondo en la que los equipos pelean por sus metas: la salvación, Europa, la Champions o el título. El Barcelona defiende corona.

programme.title: World Golf Cup Islas Canarias 2026
programme.desc: Villa, Terry, Hazard y Altidore protagonizan World Golf Cup in the Canary Islands, donde mezclan golf, recuerdos mundialistas, rivalidad y confesiones personales en plena cuenta atrás para el Mundial 2026.

programme.title: Revelado - Luis de la Fuente
programme.desc: Luis de la Fuente entró sin hacer ruido en el banquillo de la Selección, pero ha conseguido impregnar un sello propio al equipo nacional de España. Con él se han logrado Liga de Naciones y Eurocopa y ahora afronta el reto más complicado: el Mundial.

programme.title: Mundial 2026: Francia - España
programme.desc: España tiene el gigantesco reto de alcanzar la segunda final de un Mundial en su historia. La cita de Dallas centrará las miradas de todo el planeta fútbol. Francia es, para la mayoría, el gran favorito del torneo, con individualidades que marcan la diferencia.

programme.title: Bordando la segunda estrella
programme.desc: La Selección ha hecho historia en el Mundial. La cita de México, Canadá y Estados Unidos quedará guardada por siempre en la memoria de la afición española. El combinado dirigido por Luis de la Fuente alzó en Nueva York la copa y bordó la segunda estrella en el escudo.

programme.title: Talleres de Reminiscencia LaLiga
programme.desc: El documental refleja la dimensión de estos talleres a través del fútbol, destacando la sesión realizada en el museo de LEGENDS. El fútbol es una herramienta clave para que los protagonistas sean capaces de recuperar recuerdos, especialmente en personas con vínculos emocionales con el deporte. Unión perfecta para ayudar a las personas mayores a revivir recuerdos ligados al fútbol.

programme.title: Mundial 2026: Inglaterra - Argentina
programme.desc: Inglaterra y Argentina disputan en Atlanta una semifinal con muchas rencillas. Sus duelos en el pasado han dejado imágenes icónicas de los mundiales, como la mano de Dios, el gol de Maradona o la expulsión de Beckham. La albiceleste cuenta con la experiencia; los 'Three Lions', con Kane y Bellingham.

programme.title: World Golf Cup Islas Canarias 2026
programme.desc: Villa, Terry, Hazard y Altidore protagonizan World Golf Cup in the Canary Islands, donde mezclan golf, recuerdos mundialistas, rivalidad y confesiones personales en plena cuenta atrás para el Mundial 2026.

programme.title: The Making of Mourinho: El Mago
programme.desc: José Mourinho fue nombrado entrenador del Real Madrid con una complicada misión: detener al FC Barcelona de Pep Guardiola. En abril de 2012, el equipo blanco viajó al Camp Nou para jugar el Clásico sabiendo que sólo una derrota podía impedirles ganar el título de Liga.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: At. Madrid - Barcelona
programme.desc: Los mejores clubes del país protagonizan LaLiga, el campeonato de la regularidad del fútbol español. El torneo es una carrera de fondo en la que los equipos pelean por sus metas: la salvación, Europa, la Champions o el título. El Barcelona defiende corona.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Barcelona - Espanyol
programme.desc: Los mejores clubes del país protagonizan LaLiga, el campeonato de la regularidad del fútbol español. El torneo es una carrera de fondo en la que los equipos pelean por sus metas: la salvación, Europa, la Champions o el título. El Barcelona defiende corona.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Real Madrid - Barcelona
programme.desc: Nuevo episodio en la rivalidad que marca el paso en LaLiga. Real Madrid y Barcelona se miden en el Bernabéu con el liderato en juego. Los blancos, con dos puntos de ventaja, pueden poner tierra de por medio. Los culés han salido airosos en los últimos Clásicos.

programme.title: El último duelo
programme.desc: El Mundial de 2026 podría ser el último en el que coincidan Cristiano Ronaldo y Lionel Messi. Con este telón de fondo, este documental realiza un viaje al origen de la rivalidad que protagonizó el fútbol moderno y convirtió LaLiga en un fenómeno global.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Athletic - Sevilla
programme.desc: Un ilusionado conjunto vasco tras conseguir la clasificación para la Champions y retener a su figura, Nico Williams, recibe a un Sevilla que quiere volver a la élite del fútbol español.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: At. Madrid - Elche
programme.desc: El conjunto colchonero se enfrenta al Elche tras caer de forma sorpresiva en la primera jornada de liga ante el Espanyol.

programme.title: El Arquitecto. Del mito al desafío
programme.desc: Análisis en profundidad sobre la figura de Xabi Alonso, el entrenador del Real Madrid CF y actualmente en el centro de todas las miradas. El documental contrapone su etapa gloriosa como futbolista con sus éxitos iniciales como entrenador en el Bayer Leverkusen.

programme.title: The Making of Mourinho
programme.desc: Vivimos el segundo episodio del Making Off de José Mourinho, recientemente destituido como técnico del Tottenham.

programme.title: Premier Corner by Guiness 0,0
programme.desc: El recién llegado al Arsenal y ex de la Real Sociedad, Martín Zubimendi, repasa su trayectoria con Eneko en esta nueva edición de Premier Corner.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Oviedo - Real Madrid
programme.desc: El conjunto madridista vuelve a tierras asturianas después de muchas temporadas. Enfrente tendrá a un Oviedo repleto de ilusión por volver a jugar en primera ante su afición.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Rayo - Barcelona
programme.desc: Los pupilos de Flick visitan un campo siempre complicado como Vallecas.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Barcelona - Getafe
programme.desc: El estadio Johan Cruyff vuelve a acoger al Barcelona como local en partido de Liga. Los azulgranas quieren culminar una gran semana (goleada al Valencia y triunfo en Champions) sumando tres nuevos puntos. El Getafe también ha iniciado muy bien la temporada.

programme.title: Masterclass
programme.desc: Nico Williams, el talentoso extremo del Athletic Club, es el primer jugador en pasar por nuestro 'Masterclass' y analizarnos sus goles y habilidades con el balón.

programme.title: Davide, el príncipe Ancelotti
programme.desc: Entrevista con Davide Ancelotti en la que habla de su futuro como posible entrenador del Real Madrid.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Villarreal - Girona
programme.desc: El equipo castellonense recibe a un Girona a la espera de los últimos refuerzos para una plantilla con deficiencias.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Betis - Athletic
programme.desc: Enfrentamiento entre dos equipos que han empezado bien el campeonato. El conjunto vasco llega a Sevilla tras conseguir dos valiosas victorias que lo han situado en la zona Champions.

programme.title: Bordando la segunda estrella
programme.desc: La Selección ha hecho historia en el Mundial. La cita de México, Canadá y Estados Unidos quedará guardada por siempre en la memoria de la afición española. El combinado dirigido por Luis de la Fuente alzó en Nueva York la copa y bordó la segunda estrella en el escudo.

programme.title: The Making of Mourinho: El Comienzo
programme.desc: En 2003, El Manchester United de Sir Alex Ferguson recibió en Old Trafford al Oporto de José Mourinho en un tenso partido de octavos de final de la UEFA Champions League. Un encuentro que desempeñaría un papel clave en la carrera de uno de los entrenadores más exitosos de la historia.

programme.title: The Making of Mourinho
programme.desc: Vivimos el segundo episodio del Making Off de José Mourinho, recientemente destituido como técnico del Tottenham.

programme.title: The Making of Mourinho: El Mago
programme.desc: José Mourinho fue nombrado entrenador del Real Madrid con una complicada misión: detener al FC Barcelona de Pep Guardiola. En abril de 2012, el equipo blanco viajó al Camp Nou para jugar el Clásico sabiendo que sólo una derrota podía impedirles ganar el título de Liga.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: At. Madrid - Real Madrid
programme.desc: Los mejores clubes del país protagonizan LaLiga, el campeonato de la regularidad del fútbol español. El torneo es una carrera de fondo en la que los equipos pelean por sus metas: la salvación, Europa, la Champions o el título. El Barcelona defiende corona.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Real Oviedo - Barcelona
programme.desc: Los mejores clubes del país protagonizan LaLiga, el campeonato de la regularidad del fútbol español. El torneo es una carrera de fondo en la que los equipos pelean por sus metas: la salvación, Europa, la Champions o el título. El Barcelona defiende corona.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Barcelona - Athletic
programme.desc: El Barcelona regresa al Camp Nou casi 30 meses después de su último partido en su feudo. Y lo hace con un partido grande. Los azulgranas reciben al Athletic con la intención de intensificar la presión por el liderato.

programme.title: Masterclass
programme.desc: Jugadores de primer nivel muestran sus habilidades con el balón.

programme.title: Talleres de Reminiscencia LaLiga

El fútbol es una herramienta clave para que los protagonistas sean capaces de recuperar recuerdos, especialmente en personas con vínculos emocionales con el deporte. Unión perfecta para ayudar a las personas mayores a revivir recuerdos ligados al fútbol.

programme.title: Sport 50
programme.desc: Nicolas et Julia, deux athlètes engagés, ont parcouru près de 1000 kilomètres entre Paris et Chamonix, à raison de 50 kilomètres par jour pendant 20 jours. Leur objectif : aller à la rencontre de clubs sportifs, d'associations, d'élus locaux et d'experts afin de comprendre concrètement comment le changement climatique impacte la pratique du sport et comment les acteurs du secteur s'adaptent au quotidien.

programme.title: Football : Match amical

En attendant les mondialistes, lui et ses coéquipiers affrontent Majorque afin de préparer la saison à venir.

programme.title: Family Feud
programme.desc: In this original version of iconic game show "Family Feud," actor Richard Dawson plays host to two teams, each comprised of five family members, who try to match the answers given to survey questions asked to groups of people (typically 100 people in the group). The family that wins the game by being the first to reach a certain point total, either 200 or 300 depending on the rules at the time, advances to the bonus round, called Fast Money, for a chance to win thousands of dollars by answering more survey questions.

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: Two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

The family that wins the game by being the first to reach a certain point total, either 200 or 300 depending on the rules at the time, advances to the bonus round, called Fast Money, for a chance to win thousands of dollars by answering more survey questions.

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: Two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. When the time is up, the team with the most points wins, and the non-celebrity contestants wins cash.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Family Feud
programme.desc: In this original version of iconic game show "Family Feud," actor Richard Dawson plays host to two teams, each comprised of five family members, who try to match the answers given to survey questions asked to groups of people (typically 100 people in the group). The family that wins the game by being the first to reach a certain point total, either 200 or 300 depending on the rules at the time, advances to the bonus round, called Fast Money, for a chance to win thousands of dollars by answering more survey questions.

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: Two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. When the time is up, the team with the most points wins, and the non-celebrity contestants wins cash.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including 20 Emmys and three Peabody Awards.

programme.title: Accomplice to Murder, With Vinnie Politan
programme.desc: Vinnie Politan travels across the country to speak with accomplices, the convicted, condemned and exonerated, who share a unique look into cases and verdicts that might not be as clear-cut as initially thought.

programme.title: Corrupt Crimes
programme.desc: True-crime series are a staple of the TV landscape. "Corrupt Crimes" analyzes recent criminal cases through a combination of expert testimony and dramatic storytelling. From crimes like doping in sports to more serious offenses like murder, the series exposes what is really going on in each case. Exposing corruption across the United States is the goal of the series. Cases featured in the half-hour episodes include an ATM heist that resulted in nearly $45 million being stolen worldwide and the former Detroit Mayor Kwame Kilpatrick.

programme.title: It Takes a Killer
programme.desc: Some of the world's most notorious murders are the subject of "It Takes a Killer," which investigates the crimes from the perspective of the killers, trying to get inside their minds and determine their motives. Leading homicide investigators and experts from such agencies as the FBI and Scotland Yard take a look at the evidence pulled from crime scenes and profile the killer's behavior to try to piece together the details of each murder, explaining when, why and how each criminal committed the crime. For the wannabe detectives watching the show, the experts also reveal how the crime was solved -- which often requires authorities to think like a killer.

Leading homicide investigators and experts from such agencies as the FBI and Scotland Yard take a look at the evidence pulled from crime scenes and profile the killer's behavior to try to piece together the details of each murder, explaining when, why and how each criminal committed the crime. For the wannabe detectives watching the show, the experts also reveal how the crime was solved -- which often requires authorities to think like a killer.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. programme.desc: The Vegas Golden Knights host the Anaheim Ducks for Game 1 of the Western Conference Second Round at T-Mobile Arena. The Ducks advanced to this round by defeating the Oilers 4-2, while the Golden Knights eliminated the Mammoth with a 4-2 victory.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Ducks take on the Golden Knights at T-Mobile Arena for Game 2 of the West second round. Vegas leads the series after a 3-1 Game 1 win. Mitch Marner had a 162-foot empty-netter and an assist. Carter Hart was sensational, stopping 33 of 34 shots.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The West second round Game 3 gets underway as the Golden Knights play the Ducks at Honda Center. The series is tied. Anaheim used speed to stifle Vegas, with Jansen Harkins sealing the Game 2 win with an empty-net goal with 3:30 remaining.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Ducks face the Golden Knights in Game 4 of the West second round at Honda Center. The Golden Knights lead 2-1 after a 6-2 Game 3 win. In Game 3, Mitch Marner had a historic performance, recording his first playoff hat trick and four points.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: Jack Eichel leads the Golden Knights against Leo Carlsson and the surging Ducks in Game 4 with the series that is tied 2-2. After Anaheim's 4-3 victory in the last outing, Vegas relies on Jack Eichel's 10 postseason points to reclaim the series lead.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Golden Knights visit the Ducks for a crucial Game 6 of the Western Conference round. Pavel Dorofeyev scored 2 goals along with the game-winning goal in matchround 5 . Following an overtime loss in last match, the Knights lead this series 3-2.

programme.title: Journey: A Voice Lost... and Found
programme.desc: Journey dominated the American music scene in the seventies and eighties with their epic arena rock anthems and power ballads. Frontman Steve Perry was dubbed The Voice thanks to the untouchable vocal stylings that burned up the radio waves and made him a household name. But the bigger Journey got, the more miserable Perry grew. He was the rare rock superstar who craved anonymity more than applause. Then at the height of the band's success, Perry did the completely unthinkable-he quit Journey. That should've been an absolute death knell for a band so defined by a single voice. But Journey's other longtime members refused to give up the dream and brought in a new singer to keep the music going. Fans were livid that anyone would dare to try to fill Steve Perry's shoes-shows were played in empty houses and threats were even made against the band.

programme.title: The Razor's Edge
programme.desc: An American fighter pilot, Larry Darrell (Tyrone Power), returns from World War I sickened by the violence and fighting he has witnessed. In search of meaning, he travels to Paris, where he tries to live modestly. However, this leads Larry's fiancée, the status-seeking Isabel Bradley (Gene Tierney), to break off the engagement. But Isabel returns to Larry's life when he becomes romantically involved with Sophie (Anne Baxter), a troubled alcoholic recovering from tragedy.

programme.title: Tobacco Road
programme.desc: A poor family in rural Georgia struggles to make ends meet as the clan's father, Jeeter Lester (Charley Grapewin), proudly refuses help at every turn. Although the Lesters have thrived on their land for generations, Jeeter and his wife (Marjorie Rambeau) haven't prospered, and the outlook for the family is bleak. While many Lester children have left the farm, the none-too-bright Dude (William Tracy) and the gorgeous Ellie May (Gene Tierney) are still around to cause a fair share of drama.

programme.title: Toys in the Attic
programme.desc: Black sheep Julian Berniers (Dean Martin) returns home -- along with wife Lily (Yvette Mimieux) -- to his two sisters in New Orleans. Julian's shoe factory in Illinois has gone bankrupt, but he tells them he saved enough money to be comfortable. Julian's sister, Carrie (Geraldine Page), nurses a borderline incestuous affection for Julian and dislikes Lily. When Carrie overhears Julian revealing his money was swindled from Cyrus Warkins (Larry Gates), she convinces naive Lily to betray Julian.

programme.title: Crime and Punishment, U.S.A.
programme.desc: A Santa Monica, Calif., law student (George Hamilton) kills a pawnbroker, then helps a policeman (Frank Silvera) solve the crime.

programme.title: Home From the Hill
programme.desc: For his entire life, Theron Hunnicutt's mother, Hannah, has sheltered him from the philandering of his father, Wade. Despite her best efforts, Theron acquires his father's taste for women when the elder Hunnicutt takes a sudden interest in his upbringing. When Theron unexpectedly impregnates Libby, the daughter of a local shopkeeper, he struggles with conflicted feelings about marriage and his family's legacy of infidelity.

programme.title: Angel Baby
programme.desc: A Southern girl (Salome Jens) turns exploited faith healer after another (George Hamilton) restores her speech.

programme.title: A Thunder of Drums
programme.desc: Stationed in an isolated desert outpost, Lt. Curtis McQuade (George Hamilton), an inexperienced cavalry officer, must adjust to his new spartan life under his surly superior, Capt. Stephen Maddocks (Richard Boone). Tensions between the young soldier and his embittered leader are heightened by their mutual infatuation with the beautiful Tracey Hamilton (Luana Patten). When the troops have to face fierce local Apaches, will Maddocks and McQuade be able to put their differences aside?

programme.title: Two Weeks in Another Town
programme.desc: Upon being released after years in a mental hospital, fallen Hollywood star and alcoholic Jack Andrus (Kirk Douglas) moves to Rome in an attempt to revive his career, accepting a small part in an Italian production headed by aged, now-unfashionable director Maurice Kruger (Edward G. Robinson). When Kruger is sidetracked by a heart attack, Andrus steps in as director and struggles to save his mentor's picture from certain failure -- even as Kruger denounces Andrus and accuses him of betrayal.

programme.title: Doctor, You've Got to Be Kidding
programme.desc: Self-centered Harlan W. Wycliff (George Hamilton) resents the fact that his secretary and lover, Heather Halloran (Sandra Dee), is pursuing a singing career. Nevertheless, Heather quickly becomes a popular attraction when she starts working as a nightclub singer for stone-faced club owner Dan Ruskin (Mort Sahl). After fainting just before an appearance, Heather learns that she's pregnant. While she's at the hospital, three suitors attempt to marry Heather and make an honest woman of her.

programme.title: The Man Who Loved Cat Dancing
programme.desc: After serving time for avenging the murder of Cat Dancing, his Native American wife, Jay Grobart (Burt Reynolds), reluctantly takes part in a train robbery in the hopes of using his share of the loot to make a better life for his two children. When his accomplices kidnap society woman Catherine Crocker (Sarah Miles), who is on the run from her violent husband (George Hamilton), Grobart's inner decency protects her from harm as they flee from the bounty hunter (Lee J. Cobb) chasing them.

programme.title: Your Cheatin' Heart
programme.desc: Born poor in a rural southern town, Hank Williams Sr. (George Hamilton) begins playing guitar at a young age and eventually joins a traveling medicine show. With the help of Audrey (Susan Oliver), his ambitious wife, Shorty Younger (Red Buttons), his manager, and Fred Rose (Arthur O'Connell), a music publisher, Williams gains an enthusiastic fan base and becomes a country music star. However, the pressures of success soon become too much for Williams to handle.

programme.title: Where the Boys Are
programme.desc: Beautiful Midwestern college girls Angie (Connie Francis), Melanie (Yvette Mimieux), Tuggle (Paula Prentiss) and Merritt (Dolores Hart) take off to Florida for spring break. On their search for romance and adventure, Merritt falls for the charismatic Ryder Smith (George Hamilton), while Tuggle becomes briefly involved with the somewhat dim TV Thompson (Jim Hutton). Though the young women have plenty of good times, they find that the trip isn't all fun and games.

programme.title: Light in the Piazza
programme.desc: Meg Johnson (Olivia de Havilland) is very protective of her daughter, Clara (Yvette Mimieux), a gorgeous young woman who suffers from a mental disability. While on vacation in Italy, Clara meets the dashing Fabrizio Naccarelli (George Hamilton), who is immediately smitten with her and doesn't initially grasp the extent of her developmental handicap. Though Meg is wary of letting Clara fall into a romance with Fabrizio, she realizes that he may be able to give the girl a better life.

programme.title: Jack of Diamonds
programme.desc: Aspiring cat burglar Jeff Hill (George Hamilton) is eager to train in his illegal profession of choice, and finds an excellent mentor in the charming veteran thief known as "the Ace of Diamonds" (Joseph Cotten). Based on the tip of an old friend, Jeff embarks on executing a nearly impossible heist. When he's not planning his big score, Jeff also makes time to steal from a number of rich actresses, including Zsa Zsa Gabor (Zsa Zsa Gabor) and Carroll Baker (Carroll Baker).

programme.title: The Power
programme.desc: Scientists think a colleague has a deadly super brain capable of controlling others.

programme.title: Ten Cents a Dance
programme.desc: Barbara O'Neill (Barbara Stanwyck) is a poor dance hall girl who catches the eye of the wealthy Bradley Carlton (Ricardo Cortez). However, Barbara has feelings for her neighbor Eddie Miller (Monroe Owsley). After Eddie proposes to her, she says yes, and even secures a job for him from Bradley. Soon, though, Eddie has racked up deep gambling debts and even been unfaithful. Barbara continues to support him, but after he lashes out in jealousy she thinks maybe she should have chosen Bradley.

programme.title: Shopworn
programme.desc: Lovely waitress Kitty Lane (Barbara Stanwyck) is all set to marry the rich and debonair David Livingston (Regis Toomey). But David's snobbish mother, Helen (Clara Blandick), doesn't want her son consorting with Kitty's kind, so she pulls some strings with her powerful friends and has the young woman sent to jail. When Kitty gets out, she takes a singing gig in a nightclub and skyrockets to fame. David tracks Kitty down and tries to rekindle things, while Helen works on a new scheme to deter him.

programme.title: Ladies They Talk About
programme.desc: A district attorney feels a strong attraction for an imprisoned gun moll who rises to the top of the prison ladder.

programme.title: The Mad Miss Manton
programme.desc: After the murdered body discovered by beautiful, vivacious socialite Melsa Manton disappears, police and press label her a prankster until she proves them wrong.

programme.title: The Two Mrs. Carrolls
programme.desc: Geoffrey Carroll (Humphrey Bogart) is a married artist who meets the lovely Sally Morton (Barbara Stanwyck) while on vacation. Hiding his marital status from Sally, Geoffrey goes on to paint a foreboding portrait of his spouse and then kills her by gradually slipping her poison. Before long, Geoffrey woos and marries Sally, but eventually he begins an eerie painting of her, as his attention shifts to the beautiful Cecily Latham (Alexis Smith). Will the deranged Geoffrey murder again?

programme.title: My Reputation
programme.desc: Jessica Drummond (Barbara Stanwyck) is grieving after her husband's death and attempting to raise two sons alone. While on a ski holiday, she meets and falls for Maj. Scott Landis (George Brent). Their relationship is short-lived, and Jessica returns home and starts dating a new man, Frank Everett (Warner Anderson). But, when Scott moves into town, romantic confusion sets in. At the same time, community gossip about the recently widowed woman's love life threatens to tear her family apart.

programme.title: East Side, West Side
programme.desc: Wealthy New York City investment broker Brandon Bourne is a compulsive philanderer, much to the consternation of his wife, Jessie (Barbara Stanwyck). When Brandon reignites an affair with his old mistress, Isabel (Ava Gardner), Jessie seeks consolation with Mark Dwyer (Van Heflin), a policeman turned journalist. Then Isabel is found dead, and both Brandon and Jessie are suspected of the murder. Along with his former colleague Lt. Jacobi (William Conrad), Mark tries to solve the case.

programme.title: These Wilder Years
programme.desc: The wealthy yet unfulfilled Steve Bradford (James Cagney) decides it's time to atone for a troubling event. He returns to his old college town, where in his younger days he gave up for adoption a child he fathered out of wedlock. He goes to the local orphanage searching for clues and meets Ann Dempster (Barbara Stanwyck), who runs the agency. Though they are drawn to one another, Ann refuses to release any information to Steve. So out of desperation he takes legal action against her.

programme.title: The Lady Eve
programme.desc: It's no accident when wealthy Charles falls for Jean. Jean is a con artist with her sights set on Charles' fortune. Matters complicate when Jean starts falling for her mark. When Charles suspects Jean is a gold digger, he dumps her. Jean, fixated on revenge and still pining for the millionaire, devises a plan to get back in Charles' life. With love and payback on her mind, she re-introduces herself to Charles, this time as an aristocrat named Lady Eve Sidwich.

programme.title: Ball of Fire
programme.desc: Hoping to update his chapter on modern slang, encyclopedia writer Professor Bertram Potts (Gary Cooper) ventures into a chic nightclub. Inside, he meets the snarky burlesque performer "Sugarpuss" O'Shea (Barbara Stanwyck). Fascinated by her command of popular jargon, Potts invites her to stay with him. But, unknown to Potts, she is the fiancée of a mobster (Dana Andrews) and wanted by the police. In the ensuing mayhem, Potts must stay on his toes or be swallowed up by bigger fish.

programme.title: Sorry, Wrong Number
programme.desc: Due to a telephone glitch, Leona Stevenson (Barbara Stanwyck), a controlling heiress confined to a wheelchair, overhears a conversation about a plan to kill a woman. Unable to leave her home or reach her husband (Burt Lancaster), and written off by the police, Leona struggles to uncover the truth through a series of phone calls that only lead her deeper into a mystery, which may involve her college rival, Sally (Ann Richards), and a scheme to sell pharmaceuticals on the black market.

programme.title: The Strange Love of Martha Ivers
programme.desc: Young Martha inadvertently causes the death of her cruel, authoritarian aunt. Martha lies to the cops, and Walter, who saw the crime, corroborates the girl's story. Eventually, they wed out of convenience; the meek Walter is genuinely in love, and Martha thinks that her secret is safe since she has married the one witness to her aunt's death. However, when her childhood pal, Sam, shows up, Martha knows her dark past may not stay a secret for long.

programme.title: B.F.'s Daughter
programme.desc: In New York, restless Polly Fulton (Barbara Stanwyck), the daughter of wealthy industrialist B.F. Fulton (Charles Coburn), meets economics professor Tom Brett (Van Heflin) and falls for him despite his radically differing views from her father. Although Tom tries to avoid Polly when he discovers her identity, the two eventually decide to marry in spite of B.F.'s disapproval. But Polly jeopardizes the marriage when she secretly arranges to advance Tom's career, and he finds out about it.

programme.title: MGM's Big Parade of Comedy
programme.desc: This documentary from Robert Youngson features clips from a variety of classic MGM comedies. Spanning four decades worth of laughs -- and including material dating from the silent era -- this compilation includes routines from comedy greats such as Laurel and Hardy, W.C. Fields, Buster Keaton, Abbott and Costello and the Three Stooges. Highlights include Red Skelton's two-sided flag routine from "A Southern Yankee" and snippets from the Marx Brothers' "A Night at the Opera.".

programme.title: Double Dynamite
programme.desc: Johnny Dalton (Frank Sinatra), a poor bank teller who works tirelessly to save enough money to marry his doting girlfriend (Jane Russell), comes across a fortune when he rescues a duplicitous bookie (Nestor Paiva) from attackers. As a misguided sign of thanks, the bookie gives Dalton an ample cash gift -- which curiously matches the amount missing from his bank. Now suspected of embezzlement, the bewildered Dalton turns to his best friend, a wily and wacky waiter (Groucho Marx), for help.

programme.title: A Girl in Every Port
programme.desc: Inheriting $1,450 upon the death of his aunt, gullible sailor Tim Dunnovan (William Bendix) purchases a race horse, to the dismay of his best friend, Benny Linn (Groucho Marx), who assumes Tim has been swindled. Tim and Benny learn that the horse, Little Erin, has weak ankles and is a poor racer -- but his devoted groom reveals that he has a twin, Little Shamrock, in excellent condition. Discovering the whereabouts of Little Shamrock, Benny schemes to switch the horses, but complications arise.

programme.title: The Big Store
programme.desc: Private detectives Wolf J. Flywheel, Wacky and Ravelli (The Marx Brothers) are hired by the officious Martha Phelps (Margaret Dumont), co-owner of the Phelps Department Store. Her beloved nephew, Tommy (Tony Martin), has been assaulted, shortly after he announced plans to sell his share of the store. Unbeknownst to Martha, the culprit is her fiancé, sleazy store manager Mr. Grover (Douglas Dumbrille), who wants Tommy dead before the sale exposes his years of fraud and theft.

programme.title: At the Circus
programme.desc: At the Circus features the Marx Brothers (Groucho, Harpo, Chico) working together to save a circus from closing. Circus owner Jeff (Kenny Baker) needs $10,000 to pay off his business partner, John. In an effort to take over the circus himself, John allows his accomplices to steal the $10,000 from Jeff before he can pay. Loophole (Groucho Marx), a clumsy attorney who tries to help recover the money, enlists the help of wealthy Mrs. Dukesbury (Margaret Dumont).

programme.title: Room Service
programme.desc: Broadway producer Gordon Miller (Groucho Marx) has sunk every dime into his latest project but still lacks the money to get the play out of rehearsals. While dodging hotel manager Gribble (Cliff Dunstan) and his henchman, Wagner (Donald MacBride), over his unpaid bills, Gordon, director Harry Binelli (Chico Marx) and manager Faker Englund (Harpo Marx) try to soothe the jangled nerves of their playwright (Frank Albertson) and convince a wealthy backer (Philip Loeb) to invest heavily in the show.

programme.title: A Day at the Races
programme.desc: Hugo Hackenbush (Groucho Marx) is a veterinarian who masquerades as a lead doctor at Standish Sanitarium to aid the wealthy patient Emily Upjohn (Margaret Dumont). In order to save the financially failing sanitarium and its beautiful owner, Judy Standish (Maureen O'Sullivan), Hackenbush, employee Tony (Chico Marx) and jockey Stuffy (Harpo Marx) must find ingenious ways to help Gil Stewart (Allan Jones) and his inept racehorse, Hi-Hat, win the big race.

programme.title: A Night at the Opera
programme.desc: The Marx Brothers run amuck in the world of opera when Otis B. Driftwood meets aspiring singer Ricardo, who is determined to win the love of fellow performer Rosa. Aided by Fiorello and Tomasso, Otis attempts to unite the young couple, but faces opposition from the preening star Lassparri, who also has his sights on Rosa. Traveling from Italy to New York, Otis and friends rally to try and win the day.

programme.title: Go West

All three soon find themselves involved in a feud between the Turner and Wilson clans, and two crooked land promoters. In order to help two lovers marry, Quale and the Panello brothers pursue the crooks on an eastbound train in a madcap race for justice.

programme.title: The Story of Mankind
programme.desc: The Spirit of Man (Ronald Colman) debates history with the devil (Vincent Price) before a court of fate, because of the hydrogen bomb.

But when the two men start to disagree, Jeff returns to the circuit himself.

programme.title: Building Giants
programme.desc: They tower over urban landscapes, spread across city blocks and span mountainous regions, each a modern marvel of technological innovation. But how are the world's most remarkable superstructures built? This series showcases key aspects, with footage filmed during construction along with CGI to reveal building processes with astonishing detail. Take, for example, the 71,000 seat Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta. The $1.4 billion stadium is hailed as an architectural wonder because of its eight-petal retractable roof. Other episodes include a look at a cruise ship that holds more than 7,000 passengers and crew members; a flood barrier in Venice designed to prevent the ancient city from sinking into the ocean; an ambitious circular subway system running directly underneath Copenhagen, Denmark; and the world's longest suspension bridge ever built in the Arctic Circle.
